plan_changes.title: Architecture plan: TMA adult marketplace Stars-first
plan_changes.body: Recommended architecture plan: Feet-first anonymous adult marketplace as Telegram Mini App + Bot. Stack: React/Vite TMA, Nest/Fastify API, grammY bot, Postgres+Redis, private R2/S3 media with signed URLs and watermarks. Payments: Stars-only in-app; seller ledger; Fragment ops for withdrawal; platform fee 10-15%. Anonymity: public pseudonym + private seller KYC. MVP: auth, profiles, PPV, tips, escrow customs, messaging, moderation, feet tags. P1: subs, analytics, payouts, forensic WM. P2: broader

plan_changes.title: Production-ready MVP plan: scopes ops scaffold
plan_changes.body: Supersedes/extends plan-change afe6766c-3c51-426e-abc8-b41e4f5df74e. Changes: (1) MVP bar raised to production-ready including ops/admin/observability/CI/CD/backups; (2) fine-grained scopes with gap analysis under docs/SCOPES/; (3) VPS+Docker+scaling detailed; (4) GitHub CI/CD with gated migrations; (5) testing battery CI/nightly/pre-launch; (6) full admin scope; (7) monorepo scaffold docs/SCAFFOLD.md; (8) GAPS_REGISTER.md. Preserved: Stars-only, pseudonym+private KYC, feet-first, modular monoli

plan_changes.title: Subscriptions→MVP + glossary + skills matrix
plan_changes.body: Docs updated: PRODUCTION_MVP_PLAN, RESEARCH_ARCHITECTURE, GAPS G16–G22, ADR-002, GLOSSARY (Live/ZKP), SCOPES 06–09 + README waves, SKILLS_MATRIX (52 scopes), brainstorm spec, GRILLING_SESSION. No application code. Parent must continue grilling one question at a time.

plan_changes.title: Grilling closed: recommendations locked as MVP product decisions
plan_changes.body: Grilling Q1–Q13 locked via user directive (Q1=A; Q2–Q13=document recommendations). Decisions: sub-default feed + rare PPV; single tier launch (flag→1–3 flat replace); hard cut at Telegram expiry; schedule cut analytics then multi-tier; price change=archive+new tier; cancel=TMA+Telegram native; refunds=case-by-case admin runbook; renew tests=CI fixtures+one staging live sub/cancel; watermark visible+forensic flag; buyer age=attestation; counsel hard gate; fee same 10–15% as PPV; Live/ZKP/agencies

plan_changes.title: Implementation plan supersedes design-only phase
plan_changes.body: Transition: approved design → implementation plan doc. Plan path docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-21-production-mvp-implementation.md. Waves 1–9 per SCOPES README; subs 06–09 in Wave 6; Wave 1 scaffold/ops only; G01 counsel parallel track. No monorepo code this turn.

plan_changes.title: Demote large MVP plan to roadmap; execute via PIR loop plans
plan_changes.body: Demote docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-21-production-mvp-implementation.md from executable batch plan to ROADMAP INDEX. Execution moves to PIR micro-loop plan files under docs/superpowers/plans/loops/ (naming YYYY-MM-DD-<scope-slug>-loop-N-plan.md). Process documented in docs/PROCESS_PIR_LOOPS.md. Wave 1 W1.1 further split: first loop is workspace root package manager + pnpm-workspace.yaml + package name list only — no apps, no shared configs, no env schema.

plan_changes.title: Human gate: R2 not required early; MinIO unblocks media
plan_changes.body: Human gate updated: Cloudflare R2 credentials are not an early blocker. MinIO on VPS unblocks media via S3 API. Live TMA path still blocked on BotFather token (+ Stars when paying). Documented in PROCESS_PIR_LOOPS.md and RESUME.md. Related decisions: MinIO early media, i18n en+fa.

plan_changes.title: BotFather gate partially unblocked; rotate chat-pasted token
plan_changes.body: Human pasted BotFather token in chat. Token stored only in gitignored .env as FEETAPP_BOT_TOKEN. Must rotate before treating as production secret. Local initData HMAC wiring may proceed with rotated or interim local token. Username left unset until claimed. R2 still not early-required (MinIO).
